coordinateOrder: Closest RAS voxel axes; native obliquity retained
description: Three independent acquired image stacks. Each plane is 512×512 original samples; the sequences and acquisition times differ. These are not linked orthogonal cuts of one volume.
orientationNote: Cardinal labels describe the nearest anatomical direction. Each original acquisition plane is oblique, so these are approximate direction labels.

series.label: T1 · acquired axial
series.windowSource: DICOM LINEAR window from the selected central native slice, applied consistently to this stack
series.intensityMapping: uint8 = clip((native scalar value - low) / (high - low) ×255,0,255), truncated toward zero; low=center-0.5-(width-1)/2 and high=center-0.5+(width-1)/2
series.directionCosinesConvention: Columns correspond to array X,Y,Z axes; rows are R,A,S components
